# llm-abi

> A deterministic schema compatibility compiler for LLM structured outputs and tool calling.

Compile JSON Schema, Standard JSON Schema, or a closed TypeScript type subset for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, xAI, Qwen, Mistral, OpenRouter, and conservative MCP hosts. Results include a provider schema, discrete compatibility, diagnostics, loss items, a fingerprint, size hints, and runtime validation against the original schema.

- Documentation: https://llm-abi.pages.dev/docs/
- Documentation (日本語): https://llm-abi.pages.dev/docs/ja/
- Playground: https://llm-abi.pages.dev/
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/llm-abi
- API: https://llm-abi.pages.dev/docs/api/
- CLI: https://llm-abi.pages.dev/docs/cli/
- Profiles: https://llm-abi.pages.dev/docs/profiles/
- Requests: https://llm-abi.pages.dev/docs/requests/
- Local runtimes: https://llm-abi.pages.dev/docs/local/
- Guarantees: https://llm-abi.pages.dev/docs/guarantees/
- Architecture: https://llm-abi.pages.dev/docs/architecture/
- Source: https://github.com/jammaru/llm-abi

Install with `npm install llm-abi`, then call `compile(schema, "anthropic")` or another built-in target. llm-abi does not make model calls; it is the provider-compatibility gate used before the SDK or framework that does.
